title: ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF RESEARCH FELLOW.
text:
KEY LINES:
Essential Qualification:
Age: Not more than 35 years as on closing date of advertisement.
Last Date: to submit the application and proposal is 26th December, 2023, Department of Sanskrit,

FULL TEXT:
SRIMANTA SANKARDEV CHAIR
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH- 160014 (INDIA)
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF RESEARCH FELLOW
Applications along with the brief CV and proposal are invited for the post of Research Fellow to
undertake a project related to the life and contribution of Srimanta Sankardev.
Essential Qualification:
(a) 55% marks in Post Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institute.
(b) Not in receipt of any scholarship or grant /salary from any govt./state/private sector
Age: Not more than 35 years as on closing date of advertisement.
Proposal having 1800- 2000 words typed, detailed concept with chapterization, containing brief
bibliography and Research Methodology.
Fellowship: Monthly emoluments of fellowship Rs.25000/- as per norms. The research scholar will have
to present report every two months by presenting the total work done, which will be evaluated by the
experts/supervisor, failing which the scholarship will be discontinued. The position is temporary and
coterminous with the project. The fellowship will be given for a fixed period of one year.
Selection process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview in the office of Chairperson, Deptt. of
Sanskrit, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Last Date: to submit the application and proposal is 26th December, 2023, Department of Sanskrit,
Arts block-I, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Applications along with Curriculum Vitae may be submitted to the office of the Deptt. of Sanskrit by
email - skt@pu.ac.in or by post latest by 26th December, 2023. The date and time of the interview will be
informed to the shortlisted candidates by email. No separate interview letters will be issued.
Affidavit : Shortlisted candidates will have to submit an Affidavit of Rs.10/- regarding not claiming any
fellowship/grant/ scholarship/ financial assistance from any University/Board/state/Corporation etc. duly
attested by District Magistrate/ Additional District Magistrate/ Collector / Deputy Commissioner/
Additional Deputy Commissioner/ Deputy Collector/ Sub-Divisional Magistrate/ Taluka Magistrate/
Executive Magistrate/ Extra Assistant Commissioner.
NOTE: No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
Sd/
Prof. Yojna Rawat,
Coordinator,
Srimanta Sankardev Chair,
Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014
E-mail: skt@pu.ac.in
